data.author: Daniel Trugman
data.message:
Add optional filter to get_processes() and get_tasks()

Mirrors the filter pattern already used throughout the net API.
Defines task::task_filter as std::function<filter::action(const task&)>
in task.hpp and threads it through procfs::get_processes() and
task::get_tasks(). Both default to nullptr (no filtering), so existing
callers are unaffected. Adds test_procfs.cpp with five live tests
covering the unfiltered, drop-all, and keep-self cases.

data.author: Daniel Trugman
data.message:
Inherit parent project warning flags

See issue #78.

When integrating pfs as a dependency, pfs' compilation flags, which are
not private for the pfs target only, change the behaviour for the entire
project.

This commit changes the flags to be defined only when PFS is the
top-most project, and inherit the parent flags when it isn't.

data.author: Daniel Trugman
data.message:
Add comments to magic constants missing context

ROOT_KERNEL_TASK_ID = 2: note that PID 2 is kthreadd, parent of all
kernel threads. HEADER_LINES = 2 in get_dev(): note that /proc/net/dev
has two header rows (title + column names), distinguishing it from all
other net files which have one. All other named constants in the parsers
already carry sufficient context.

data.author: Daniel Trugman
data.message:
Handle '-' instances count in /proc/modules parser

Some modules (e.g. shiftfs) report '-' for the instance count in
/proc/modules. The parser only handled '-' for the dependencies field,
causing a parser_error when stot() received a non-numeric value.

Treat '-' instances as 0 and add a test case covering this format.

data.author: Daniel Trugman
data.message:
Rename file_parser to kv_file_parser, add CONTRIBUTING.md

Renames the file_parser<T> base class and its header to kv_file_parser
to make the key-value format immediately clear at the call site. Updates
all three subclasses (task_status_parser, task_io_parser, proc_stat_parser)
and their headers accordingly.

CONTRIBUTING.md documents the two parser patterns (kv_file_parser<T> for
key-value files, parse_file_lines for tabular files) with step-by-step
instructions, error handling conventions, and a license/copyright notice
modelled on the DCO 1.1.

data.author: Daniel Trugman
data.message:
Fix npos wrap in get_stat() comm field parsing

`find_last_of(')')` returns `npos` when no closing parenthesis is found,
causing `npos - 1` to wrap to `SIZE_MAX - 1` and the subsequent seek to
land in garbage. Detect this and the `close_paren == 0` case early and
throw a precise "Corrupted stat - Malformed comm field" error. Also use
`close_paren` directly in the seek calculation instead of re-deriving the
offset from `st.comm.size()` after reassignment.

data.author: Daniel Trugman
data.message:
Add O_CLOEXEC to all open() calls

File descriptors opened without O_CLOEXEC are inherited by child processes
after fork+exec. In a multithreaded program, a thread can fork+exec a child
while another thread has a pfs fd open, leaking it to the child.

mid-iteration. Documents the correct pattern of catching
std::system_error from individual getters.

data.message:
Device number parsing: Handle decimal/hexadecimal representations

The device number (major:minor) is being represented in different bases across different sources:
- procfs `maps`: hexadecimal
- procfs `mountinfo`: decimal
- sysfs `block/dev`: decimal

This commit handles parsing of these different representations.

Changes:
- Explicitly setting the wanted base for each parsing flow
- Added UT case to cover the new functionality

data.author: Joey Shao
data.message:
fix comm field in /proc/pid/stat

Although in man page:
    https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man5/proc.5.html
The comm field has a description: `Strings longer than
TASK_COMM_LEN (16) characters (including the
terminating null byte) are silently truncated.`
However, if you check the kernel code in fs/proc/array.c,
you will find that the description is only valid in the
`__get_task_comm(tcomm, sizeof(tcomm), p);` branch of
`proc_task_name` function. The actual maximum length
is 64 instead. Hence the change and the added tests.

data.author: Daniel Trugman
data.message:
Adjust to compilation as CMake sub-directory

**NOTE:** This change breaks backward compatibility, by changing the
CMake configuration options.

Avoid possible option collisions when using pfs as sub-directory.
Some options are supposed to be inherited from the project and are common
CMake flags, like the `CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE` or `BUILD_SHARED_LIBS`.
Whereas other flags are not supposed to be shared, and hence should are
to be prefixed with the project name.

Using `pfs_` for the prefix, rather than `PFS_` because CMake
automatically generates some library specific variables (Check that out
by looking at `CMakeCache.txt`) and uses the project name (`pfs`) as the
prefix.
This choice has been also observed in protobuf's CMake code.

data.author: Daniel Trugman
data.message:
Return vectors instead of sets for most APIs

Except for the process enumeration API, where it feels native to return
a container sorted by the PIDs, most other APIs should probably retain
the order in the file, instead of sorting the values.

This required a change in the parser implementation, since we cannot use
`emplace` with `std::vector`. So now, instead of creating and returning
the container, we accept an inserted and let the caller decide which
container to use and how to fill it.

Added a unittest to verify that the new version of parse_lines moves the
objects.
